deals.whyRanked: JetBlue's own site still shows $59 one-way in both directions (Oct 14-20, plus scattered November/December dates) — flat for a third straight day and still tied for cheapest, with the highest solo score of the five.
deals.soloWhy: The Metro reaches nearly every monument and museum, the Mall is safe to walk solo well into the evening, and the Smithsonians are free.

highlights: National Mall monuments lit up after dark
Great Falls Park overlook on the Potomac
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, drop bags, catch the National Archives before close, then walk the Mall monuments once they're lit and empty.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Shenandoah: Skyline Drive south to Hawksbill or Stony Man summit, back for a Capitol Hill dinner.
Day 3 — Kayak the Potomac at Great Falls in the morning, wander Eastern Market before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Metro covers the Mall, museums, and most neighborhoods; a rental car is only needed for Shenandoah or Great Falls.
guide.stayArea: Near a Metro stop on the Orange/Blue/Silver line (Capitol Hill or Foggy Bottom) for the fastest reach to the Mall.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant's fare calendar shows $56 one-way TYS-to-BOS (Nov 7) and $62 the other direction (Nov 14) — the outbound leg ticked up a few dollars from earlier this week but the route still pairs to roughly $118 round trip, keeping it essentially tied with DC.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to explore alone on foot, and the park's Greenbrier and Cosby entrances are quieter than the Cades Cove side.

highlights: Market Square street music and farmers' stalls
Ijams Nature Center quarry swimming hole
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Greenbrier entrance
itinerary: Day 1 — Knoxville Museum of Art on arrival, Market Square for dinner and live music.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Greenbrier: Ramsey Cascades trail (round trip ~8 miles) or the gentler Porters Creek loop past old homesteads.
Day 3 — Ijams Nature Center quarry swim in the morning, Old City bars before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and Ijams are walkable or a short rideshare apart; a rental car is required to reach the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square or Gay Street — walkable, close to restaurants and the Tennessee Theatre.

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue's own site holds at $80 one-way in both directions (Oct 10, 17, 20, 27, 31), unchanged for several days running and still comfortably ahead of Denver on price.
deals.soloWhy: Las Olas Boulevard and the beachfront promenade stay busy and walkable well into the evening, with the free Sun Trolley covering downtown.

itinerary: Day 1 — Beachfront promenade walk on arrival, sunset at the pier, dinner on Las Olas.
Day 2 — Everglades NP Shark Valley: rent a bike for the 15-mile paved loop, alligators guaranteed at the observation tower.
Day 3 — Hugh Taylor Birch State Park trails and lagoon in the morning, Riverwalk stroll before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free Sun Trolley covers downtown and the beach; a rental car is worth it for the Everglades day trip.
guide.stayArea: Las Olas or the beachfront — walkable, close to restaurants and the water taxi stops.

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue's fare calendar holds flat at $99 one-way in both directions, unchanged from yesterday's jump — the Rocky Mountain National Park boost keeps Denver just ahead of Tampa despite the higher fare floor.
deals.soloWhy: The 16th Street Mall and RTD light rail make downtown and the Highlands easy to cover on foot or transit, and Union Station is a lively, safe evening hub.

highlights: Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor
itinerary: Day 1 — Larimer Square and Union Station on arrival, RiNo brewery crawl at dusk.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: Bear Lake Road trailheads (Dream Lake or Emerald Lake), back by evening.
Day 3 — Denver Art Museum and Red Rocks at sunrise, a last meal in LoDo before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The A Line train connects the airport to Union Station; RTD light rail and buses cover downtown, but a rental car is needed for Rocky Mountain NP or Red Rocks.
guide.stayArea: LoDo (Lower Downtown) near Union Station — walkable to Larimer Square, the light rail, and RiNo.

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue's outbound leg is still $95 one-way, but the return (TPA-to-BOS) climbed to $155 today from the $95 seen recently, pushing the realistic round trip up — Tampa still rounds out the top 5 since no cheaper unverified alternative (a since-expired $137 Nashville sale) panned out.
deals.soloWhy: The free TECO Line streetcar links downtown, the Riverwalk, and Ybor City, so evenings out don't require a car or rideshare.

highlights: Ybor City's cigar factories and Cuban sandwiches
itinerary: Day 1 — Florida Aquarium on arrival, Riverwalk stroll at sunset.
Day 2 — Free streetcar to Ybor City: cigar factory tours, 7th Avenue murals, Columbia Restaurant for dinner.
Day 3 — Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park in the morning, Armature Works food hall before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free TECO Line streetcar connects downtown, the Channel District, and Ybor City; a rideshare covers the beaches, which are 30-45 minutes out.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or the Channel District — walkable to the Riverwalk and a streetcar ride from Ybor City.
